Scheduled/likely events: the December FOMC (FinanceFeeds relays a near-certain hike priced, src 16), continued AI/semis risk-off after the Nov sell-off (src 16, src 17), the shareholder suit (src 14, no near-term cash effect), and possible customer announcements (CEO: 'a couple' of foundry/packaging customers ready to announce in the next two quarters, src 5; first 18A-P customer signed but unnamed, src 15). Short-horizon regularities pull both ways: post-earnings-drift and negative momentum after a -29% gap vs reversal after a ~58% drawdown. reasoning: Lane (alternative): supply-chain and channel data (IDC Q3 units -20.1%, src 10; TrendForce PC DRAM +13-18% in 4Q26 and notebook shipments still falling, src 9; Steam survey shows buyers dropping from 32GB to 16GB configs, src 12 - a demand-side sign that memory cost is binding), Mercury share data (Intel desktop share up to 70.1% but AMD server share up to 35.5%, src 11), two independent Substacks written the day after the print (TradingToni's post-print model FY2027 EPS $1.68 non-GAAP, src 7; Beyond The Hype's case that OEMs over-ordered in 1H26 and that 2027 PC units could fall more than 10%, src 8), and Polymarket (no open Intel markets, src 13). The stock fell from $119 (late Sept) to $59.66 after a Q4 guide of $15.0-16.0B revenue and $0.25 non-GAAP EPS: the August $95 equity sale (src 14) had been priced on an agentic-AI CPU story that ignored the PC exposure. Build: PC TAM x capture (CCPG ~$26.5B in 2027), server units x capture (DCAI ~$37.5B in 2027, management's ~$34B Q4 annualised start plus back-end growth), small Other; corporate loss narrowing from -$12B to -$11B. EPS after SBC and NCI $1.29 FY2027 and $1.78 FY2028; on a non-GAAP (pre-SBC) basis that is ~$1.75 for FY2027, close to TradingToni's $1.68 (src 7) and well below pre-print street hopes (the Q4 EPS guide alone was ~42% below consensus, src 7). Value: 40x (k = 0.8 shrink) on NTM EPS -> $72; normalised leg $61; blend $69.5, ~+17% vs $59.66. Scenarios move the drivers the playbook names (PC units, server units, share/ASP, margin) plus the multiple: P10 $34, P90 $111. Research limits: sec.gov refused scripted downloads (403), the shared WebFetch budget ran out (so only one quarter of guidance record is scored and no dated post-print consensus page was opened; the Yahoo consensus page looked pre-print and was not used), X was not reachable. Not driver-linked: the normalised-EPS custom leg.

model_inputs.structure_note: Value carried by a P/E horizon leg (0.75) on the build's own GAAP after-SBC NTM EPS at 2027-11-23 (mostly FY2028), plus a normalised-EPS cross-check leg (0.25). Driver build: PC unit TAM x CCPG capture; server CPU unit TAM x DCAI capture; Other residual; segment margins and a corporate line (foundry loss + unallocated + eliminations). No DCF (policy). No FCF-yield leg: FCFF is negative in FY2026-27 (CFO: no positive FCF in 2027, src 5), so the >=2% FCF margin test fails. NCI deducted as an equity-level adjustment because the P/E leg does not net NCI earnings. Annual set (not quarterly): a quarterly rebuild needs Kilian's driver approval card and filed quarter segment data I could not fetch (sec.gov 403 to scripts; shared WebFetch budget exhausted).
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) exit k = 0.8 on an own multiple (46.2x) inflated by trough PC earnings and foundry losses; k = 0.7 would give ~36x and about -9% on the research target (12m), k = 0.9 ~44x and about +9% - card if the supervisor keeps this set. (2) NCI at 20x its $800M run-rate earnings ($16B); at the 40x equity multiple it would be $28B (-$2.2/share). (3) Equity raise in the next 12 months: ~10% (net cash $3.9B at Q3 per F87, ~$54B cash and short-term investments, FY2027 FCFF about -$1.2B in this build; the $95 August offering is already in the share count), below the 20% bar, so no financing event. (4) Q1 2026 segment split (CCPG ~7.7B, DCAI ~5.0B) is an estimate; only the Q1 total is filed in the fact pack.
